subject.title: [Feature]: Emit cron_changed scheduled events after durable wake changes

question: Should `cron_changed` permanently expose the already-documented `scheduled` action for every successful durable effective wake-time change outside explicit add, update, and remove operations?
rationale: The documentation already promises the action, but maintainers must confirm its permanent plugin API scope and reconciliation semantics across quiet ticks, retries, maintenance, cancellation, and startup catch-up.

options.title: Implement the documented invariant
options.body: Add the action at the durable cron-state owner boundary with lifecycle duplicate suppression and full-list reconciliation guidance.

options.title: Withdraw the documentation promise
options.body: Remove `scheduled` from public documentation and leave plugins dependent on existing lifecycle events plus Gateway startup reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Implement the documented invariant
recommendation.body: Add the action at the durable cron-state owner boundary with lifecycle duplicate suppression and full-list reconciliation guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and extended the current public cron hook contract in merged history.
